Manuscript additions to printed map, sectioned in 6 and mounted on cloth. Title made from adhesive letters. Sources of newspapers marked with red stickers, with the place names underlined with red pencil. Accompanied by a list of cities on two typed pages, dated October 1 1928, annotated in pencil, and signed "H.S. Parsons". 27 x 21 cm.
